punchline: Navarro says feet are the most honest part of the body because we forget to watch them.
thirty_sec: Joe Navarro, a former FBI agent, says the brain reacts to threat before we think: feet turn toward the door, shoulders rise, a hand goes to the neck. He calls the limbic system the honest brain. These are not proof of lying, and research finds such cues weak. They are a reason to ask a gentle question, not to pass a verdict.
